unit: Number of archived junctions with a previously uncredited target meeting each condition; junctions share episodes.
protocol: Max 24 total actions or remaining official budget. V16 pays four scan actions. Test nominal chosen route until budget, route end, or first simulated collision. new_in_range and new_in_view exclude targets already in range/in view at the decision start. Sight threshold 103 semantic pixels in one 320px frame. Reach uses official .25m viewpoint geodesic rule. No VLM replanning, official report or extra trajectory after a branch ends; offline local opportunity only.
